title: Round 28: round 25's DAgger recipe on neto1 v3 (32 heads), teacher u 0.25 or 0.375, three seeds
description: Round 26's recipe unchanged (experiments/neto2-r26-v2.json) on neto1 v3 (release exp-neto1-v3-264: neto1 v2's 27 heads plus the same five composites as net1 v10), with the rule on neto1 v3 at u = 0.25 or 0.375 as teacher and start, seeds 1 to 3. The twin of round 27.
prepare: N="$IN/n/$(cat "$IN/n/chosen.txt")/net1.pt"; uv run python experiments/net2_ppo_setup.py "$OUT/setup" --net1 "$N" --models "$IN/models" --u 0.25; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/setup/rule" "$N" --u 0.375
run: S="$OUT/spec-r28-u$U-s$SEED.json"; jq --arg rule "$OUT/setup/rule/rule-u$U.onnx" --argjson u "$U" --argjson seed "$SEED" '.rule_policy = $rule | .u_rule = $u | .algo = "dagger" | .student = {"kind": "gate3", "threshold": 0.5} | .view = "means" | .share_k = 0.5 | .critic_warmup = 0 | .lr = 0.001 | .updates_per_iteration = 50 | .replay_iterations = 16 | .tau_s = 1 | .noise_sigma = 0.05 | .group = 1 | .links_per_iteration = 32 | .compete = 0.8 | .copies = [2, 4] | .seed = $seed | .iterations = 60 | .eval_every = 20' "$OUT/setup/ppo-base.json" > "$S"; uv run expliccit train ppo "$S" "$OUT/ppo-r28-u$U-s$SEED" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS"
